featured_reviews.name: Nisha Sheth
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Team TDAS

The entire team is incredible.
Nritya 6 was a big hit. We have witnessed previous shows but every year it gets better and better.
This is because of the hard work and efforts you all put in day and night. From selecting the songs to editing them, from choreographing to training the students, from short listing the materials to designing to getting all the costumes stitched in time and most importantly from stage rehearsal Checks to final performances, everything your team does is upto perfection.
What the audience sees on stage must be just a 2 -3 minutes performance, but the efforts behind every single performance are of more than 20 hours. But in the end it is all worth with the crazy shout outs from the audiences.
I don’t know how do you all manage everything and still keeping your cool and patience with each and every performer. Each and every faculty at the institute is so patient with the students, be it with small kids or us adults. The love, care and comfort you all give them is just incredible, which, when we parents leave our kids with you all, we are never worried about them, because we know they are in very safe hands.
My daughter was being trained by Swathi mam. The change I have seen in her in this entire year is amazing. She has groomed and improved so much, it is all because of her patience amazing dancing skills and super amazing teaching skill. Thank you mam.
My journey throughout the year has been with Priyanka mam has been so amazing that I can’t describe in words, still shall try to brief it. She is an amazing person, very soft at heart and most importantly very patient with us. We must have eaten up her head and we have also been very naughty at times, but she has always been there to help us, handle us and our tantrums, support us and over all deal with us 😂. Thank you mam you are a wonderful person inside out.

Congratulations
Shweta mam, Shraddha mam, Maitri mam, Priyanka mam, Swathi mam, Niyati mam, Avisha mam, Diya mam, Shubham sir and also Venkatesh - on the great success of this beautiful event which has marked a special place in everyone’s hearts.
Cheers to team TDAS, proud to be a part of this.

Lots of love - Heya and Nisha

Dear Owner of Creative Stepz Studio,

I hope this message finds you well. I want to express my gratitude for reaching out and requesting feedback regarding my recent experience at your studio. I appreciate your willingness to listen to the concerns of your visitors and work towards creating a better environment for all.

1. While I understand that mosquitoes are prevalent in our city, I do believe that more effort can be made to fumigate the area in the studio's compound. I don't wish to single out your studio, but addressing this issue could significantly enhance the overall experience for all your visitors.

2. One of the main concerns I encountered during my visit was related to the restroom facilities. My 3-year-old child needed to use the restroom, and the only available option seemed to be a common restroom shared with the security personnel. I have no problem with the shared restroom concept, but it's crucial that cleanliness and hygiene are maintained. Unfortunately, the condition of the restroom left much to be desired - there was urine on the seat, a lack of tissues, urine on the floor, an unpleasant odor, and no hand tissues for drying. Ensuring the cleanliness and hygiene of such shared facilities is essential.

Turning off the air conditioners and banging on doors to rush people out of the studio can be quite distressing, especially when there are young children present. It's important to remember that children may require a little extra time to gather their things.

In conclusion, I've taken the step of requesting the activity provider to move out of your space because I believe it's not a safe environment for my child, and the basic amenities, like a clean restroom, are not being provided. Given the prime location of your studio, I had higher expectations.

I hope this feedback is taken in the best spirit and that it leads to improvements that benefit all visitors. Thank you for your attention to these concerns, and I hope to see positive changes in the near future.

featured_reviews.review_text: Disha & Jiten are an amazing team.. They made our entire wedding more memorable and stand out ..right from song selection, choreography, scheduling practices for 3 different time zones, top notch creativity to execution on the D Day. Every person at the wedding was hooked on till the end! Thank you soo much team Kalanath ❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Sonali Gujarathi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jiten & Disha are really very helpful and on top of teaching all the choreography and very accommodating for taking both offline and online classes to teach us songs for our sangeet. From the start they guided us from selection of songs to ensuring that we feel comfortable and learn seamlessly the choreography. They really made us feel very comfortable even on the sangeet day where Disha was there to help and gather each and every group of relatives/friends ensuring a smooth and out of the world function.
Jiten is very proactive in teaching and taking multiple practices till all the groups master the choreography. Both make a great team at the academy and can make non-dancers learn and dance on the stage without fear and with great grace.

featured_reviews.name: RIDDHEE PARMAR
featured_reviews.review_text: I had the pleasure of learning dance with Disha ma'am and Jiten for my own sangeet. They have been super accommodating , adjusting with our time schedules and making sure we revise the dance. Me and my partner are from Canada and Jiten taught our couple dance online. He was very patient with us throughout the process and so helpful considering the time difference.  Disha ma'am was the hype person I needed because I wanted to do 5-6 performances as a bride in a heavy lehenga. They were also present at the event helping my family rehearse last moment as well as prompt dance steps for the people dancing on the stage. I will highly recommend Kalanath Dance Academy to people :)

featured_reviews.name: Neel Amonker
featured_reviews.review_text: Disha and Jiten are amazing teachers! They choreographed our wedding dance and all Sangeet dances and they were superb! They understood the vibe of each group that wanted to dance and gave steps accordingly. They were also diligent in making us practice and coordinated with our event managers to ensure everything ran smoothly! The dance were really fun to learn as well.  We had a great experience with them and highly recommend them!

Our academy has worked alongside brands like Hershey’s, Amazon, Hiranandani Developers, OnePlus etc. NBSI students have also represented India in over 8 countries and on a national level have won multiple awards for their various performances. featured_reviews.name: Jessica Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text:
National Ballet School of India (NBSI) is genuinely the best Ballet Institution I have come across. The instructors are not only highly qualified but also enriched with National & International Ballet experiences. I have seen my daughter grow at each level, perform at both National & International platforms and most importantly get UNESCO Accreditation. They have  perfectly designed Training Modules for each level, several batches to ensure students can attend maximum classes, competitive exams and opportunities to participate in various events and competitions in India and Internationally.
Highly Recommended for all aspiring Ballerinas.

featured_reviews.name: Keira Munim
featured_reviews.review_text:
NBSI teachers are extremely dedicated.  They help time and again , provide many opportunities that can vary across so many age categories and have the best of students made from only the best of teachers . They are very good at recognizing talents that students have and always include every single students in the classes . The environment that the teachers provide is very encouraging, open , safe and altogether fun while also maintaining the discipline and dedication that ballet requires.
They have the best dance teachers I've visited and studied under

featured_reviews.name: Kajal Rawal
featured_reviews.review_text: Best Place! To learn ballet You feel welcomed immediately feel strong family atmosphere when you first walk in NBSI!! As my experience I feel pride and a good work ethic when pursuing your passion for ballet dance, Incredible teachers who are so supportive genuinely cared about me and about what I was going through. and they not only offer challenging technique classes but a place for me to build my confidence level up and They are not just teaching about dancing developing wonderful friendships and learning valuable life lessons that will serve us well in the future..The environment and My experiences really cultivated my love for ballet dance! All kudos goes to Dhvani you’re amazing and I’m rooting to you!! 🩰🫶🏻💗😇🥰

featured_reviews.name: Meher Kotwani
featured_reviews.review_text: If you’re in search for a ballet class, look no further! All the instructors at NBSI are professionally trained and take the time out to give each student personal attention. The best part is that the students get opportunities to participate in various national and international ballet competitions that gives them the exposure and confidence required to master their skills!

featured_reviews.name: Kiara Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: It's one of the best places to learn Ballet. Ms Dhvani is the reason why my daughter has continued Ballet for the last 7 years. She is always encouraging the girls to dream big and also gives a lot of opportunities to perform on stage. So if you are looking for a ballet class NBSI the right choice. Kids truly love going to the class and enjoy it and are welcomed warmly.

featured_reviews.name: Archie Dalmia
featured_reviews.review_text: You know you’ve landed at the right place if you/ your kid is learning ballet at NBSI! NBSI is UNESCO CID certified and has the best mentors and team with professional qualifications to technically teach and guide the students with utmost care and patience. Each student is given personal attention and zillion opportunities to participate in various national and international competitions. This school not only builds your child’s confidence but also helps shape their overall personality. Truly, none other like NBSI!

featured_reviews.name: Snehil Kumar Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text: The best school for learning International ballet dancing by a professional teacher and yet live stage performer.

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Gadhia
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been with NBSI since a really long time! It has been amazing learning and performing with them. It has really helped me as a dancer and given me various opportunities especially for someone who has been learning ballet for over 9-10 years now. I think NBSI is the right place if you want to learn ballet.

featured_reviews.name: Ojas Mate
featured_reviews.review_text: I walked in Step and Soul studio dreading it and left already checking the schedule for next week. Nidhi is a fabulous instructor, her energy is contagious, the playlist is perfection, and she somehow pushes you harder than you thought possible while making it fun. She remembers your name, stays after class, and genuinely cares about every person in that room. She adapts the workouts catering to individuals with any previous injuries. Her Zumba lessons are my personal favourite. Best cardio class I’ve ever taken — book it, you won’t regret it.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Advani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nidhi is a lovely instructor,who makes the classes engaging,I equally love the variety of sessions she has! Infact,I had my very first garba class & learnt in a very calm manner,the energy is quite positive,safe and welcoming in her classes. I am glad I signed up with Step n Soul to feed my soul with the happy hormones and would highly recommend/encourage the audience to sign up too!💖✨
P.s-a little snippet from our garba evening-an amazing mix of culture,dance & shakti together!✨

featured_reviews.name: Ruchi Swani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been attending this fitness class for a while now, it’s been a really well-rounded and enjoyable experience. Specially the Zumba sessions are energetic and fun with some great music that makes cardio feels less like a workout and more of a stress reliever.

Our instructor Nidhi is knowledgeable, supportive and makes sure everyone is following a proper form to prevent injuries and boost confidence.

The class environment is friendly and welcoming, making it easy to stay consistent.

featured_reviews.name: Minal Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Step N Soul has been an incredible fitness journey for my husband and me together. We’ve been attending the classes as a couple for the past 6 months, and the transformation has been truly visible. Nidhi is an absolute powerhouse of a trainer — she pushes you beyond what you think your limits are, and then reminds you that you’re capable of even more.. Our energy levels, stamina, agility, posture, and even our step dance skills have improved so much. Every session feels challenging yet fun, and you leave feeling stronger and more confident each time. Highly recommend Step N Soul to anyone looking for a fitness class that actually delivers results while keeping things engaging and uplifting. It keeps you coming back excited — Step N Soul is it. Couldn’t recommend it more ❤️🔥

featured_reviews.name: Rishika Mody
featured_reviews.review_text: Nidhi's classes are absolutely brilliant covering everything from strength, step aerobics, dance and pilates. Perfect place to unwind after day's work and focus on one's fitness. The energy in these classes is infectious and Nidhi's smile and motivation helps you to keep going on. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Rima Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sessions at Step N Soul are super fun because Nidhi is an incredible trainer whose energy is contagious, she's professional and not only motivates each and everyone but also adapts the exercises catering to individual issues like knee pain or back pain.
I can't recommend her enough! I really look forward to all her sessions which are well structured whether it's Strength or Pilates. And especially love her coreography in Zumba.
Truly inspiring the way she is so passionate about what she does!

featured_reviews.name: Simran Dandekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Step N Soul is such a fun place for workouts! I never get bored because there's always something new: functional workouts, mat Pilates, step aerobics, zumba, and more – I especially love Zumba! Nidhi's energy is amazing, she really pushes you through the whole workout. I am really happy to be a part of Step N Soul.

featured_reviews.name: Avani Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nidhi is the best fitness teacher that I could ask for in my journey!! A person like me who could barely follow her dance steps in my first Zumba class - now grooves to every song that she plays in class and even when i am out and hear the song playing! She nudges gently to go beyond the comfort level in her functional and mat pilates class, ensures you don’t give up on yourself and makes the entire class so much fun!!

Her enthusiasm is unparalleled and there is so much positive energy and vibe in her classes.  An array of fitness programs to choose from! This is the best one hour I look forward to in my day! ❤️
